includes: The service: exactly what you sell, with a before and after, so you can explain it in one sentence
Who buys: three filters and a 20-lead search you can run today, so you are not guessing who to message
The free 60-second sample pitch: word-for-word messages that show your work on their own video, so you never need a sales call
Pricing: your real cost per minute and a worked example, so you never quote below your cost

faq: Why is it only $4?
I co-own Grafsy, the software the guide uses. I earn if you buy the tool, so the guide is cheap. Weigh what it says with that in mind.
Do I need editing skills?
No. You upload a finished video and download it back with graphics on it. You watch the result before you send it.
Does it guarantee clients?
No. It gives you the method, the messages and the math. Finding and closing clients is your work.
